name: Jerry Moran

issue_poll.name: Emerson College Polling Kansas survey, Oct 27–29, 2022; Emerson Kansas survey, Sept 15–18, 2022; Pew Research Center national survey, Oct 10–16, 2022
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–4 from the October Emerson most-important-issue question (economy 50%, threats to democracy 14%, abortion 10%, health care 7%); 'threats to democracy' mapped to elections/voting. Immigration (7%) added from the September Emerson poll (https://emersoncollegepolling.com/?p=1678). Emerson published only those items, so ranks 6–10 come from Pew's national 'very important' list (education 64%, energy 61%, violent crime 61%, gun policy 57%, Supreme Court 55%): https://www.pewresearch.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/20/2022/10/PP_2022.10.20_midterms-economy_REPORT.pdf

issues.position: Curb spending; oppose IRA tax increases and added IRS agents
issues.note: H.R.1 extended the 2017 tax cuts and rescinded some IRS funding. Vote source: https://kansasreflector.com/2025/07/01/kansas-two-republican-u-s-senators-vote-to-pass-big-beautiful-bill/

issues.position: Reject federalizing elections; oppose federal mandates on counties
issues.note: The SAVE America Act sets federal proof-of-citizenship rules that counties must administer. Vote source: https://watch.vote/votes/119-2026-s57

issues.position: Leave abortion policy to the states, not federal law

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: Failed 49-44; only Collins and Murkowski among Republicans voted yes, and Moran was not among absentees (https://www.dailypress.senate.gov/wednesday-july-10-2024). No national-ban vote held.

issues.position: No specific position found; cited 2022 PACT Act veterans' care
Keep Title 42 border expulsions in place
issues.note: Title 42 expired in May 2023 with no Senate floor vote on keeping it.

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of the student loan debt relief rule (CRA)
votes.question: On passage

issues.position: Expand federal oil and gas leasing; stop SPR drawdowns
issues.note: H.R.1 required federal onshore and offshore oil and gas lease sales.

issues.position: More police resources; enforce existing laws (no specific measure)
Oppose new gun laws restricting legal gun owners

caveats: Emerson published only 4–5 Kansas issues, so ranks 6–10 rely on national Pew data.
Moran held no debate and skipped candidate questionnaires; positions come from news coverage, a newspaper voter guide and 2022 Senate releases.
Elections scored Contradicted on the SAVE America Act; the ar-boozman file left a similar vote unscored because his stance also backed voter ID, which Moran's 2022 statement did not mention.
Abortion vote inferred from the 49-44 tally and absentee list; roll call numbers 211, 135 and 372 taken from other researched files, not a Moran-specific source.
